Ext.description: Vendor-namespaced extension object per SPEC.md §4.5.1. Each immediate key MUST be a reverse-DNS namespace; structure under each namespace is opaque to the framework.
Ext.title: Ext

generations.description: Every generation the service still honours, newest first. Exactly one is current. Empty when the service holds no rotating identity.

current.description: True for the generation the DID document currently advertises.

expiresAt.description: When the service stops honouring it and drops its key material. Absent on the current one.

mediatorDid.description: The mediator the generation was reached through. Absent for one reached without a mediator.

retiredAt.description: When the generation stopped being current. Absent on the current one.

signingKeyId.description: Verification-method id of the generation's signing key, as the DID document names it. Public; never key material.

rotationGraceSeconds.description: How long a generation superseded now would keep being honoured.
